subject: Funding waterfall, milestone triggers & tax routing instructions
messages:
From: Sophie Li <sophie@stellartech.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinanceOps <acct@stellartech.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Funding waterfall and milestone routing (StellarTech annual commit)

Hi David —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We signed the SOW yesterday and Finance asked me to confirm the exact invoice phasing and bank routing so they can schedule the wire. Key asks from them:

- A simple waterfall that shows which invoices map to which delivery milestones (Q1 credit release, Q3 expansion draw).
- Which invoices will be held in escrow vs. standard remit.
- Confirmation of any tax/VAT evidence they need on file to avoid withholdings.

I attached the SOW for reference. Can you send a proposed schedule and the invoice number format you need?

Best,
Sophie
StellarTech — Head of Platform Partnerships
[attachment: signed_SOW_StellarTech.pdf (pdf)]

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Li <sophie@stellartech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Funding waterfall and milestone routing (StellarTech annual commit)

Sophie —

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the SOW. Attached is a draft funding waterfall (v2) that maps the three committed tranches to milestone windows and indicates which amounts are escrowed. High level:

- Invoice 1 (Activation) — 40% of committed ARR, due on contract signature. Sent as standard remit.
- Invoice 2 (H1 Delivery) — 30%, scheduled for 2027-01-15; held in escrow until acceptance tests pass.
- Invoice 3 (Expansion Trigger) — 30%, scheduled for 2027-07-01; released on milestone sign-off or auto-release at 60 days.

For tax/VAT: we need StellarTech's VAT certificate for any VAT-exempt routing. If you anticipate local withholdings, please also provide the remittance bank country and preferred invoice recipient email (we prefer acct+<account-id>@stellartech.com to auto-tag).

Attachments: funding_waterfall_v2.xlsx (waterfall + ledger tags).

Marissa / Ben — can you confirm invoice numbering (proposal: ST-2026-DL421-001, -002, -003) and whether we want escrow to be a separate remit/payee? Also flag any ledger tagging required for country tax reserves (US vs EU).

Thanks,
David
Director, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
[attachment: funding_waterfall_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Funding waterfall and milestone routing (StellarTech annual commit)

David / Ben — quick ops note after looking at the waterfall:

- Invoice numbering OK with me: ST-2026-DL421-001..003.
- Escrow: we need a separate remit_to for the escrowed tranche (legal requires escrow account on invoice). If StellarTech will wire directly to escrow, we should include both payee lines on the invoice and put escrow as the primary for Invoice 2.
- VAT evidence: we require the pax VAT cert (vat_certificate_StellarTech.pdf). If they can provide country tax registration + certificate, we will mark invoice as 'exempt' and avoid VAT line. Otherwise we default to applying VAT at invoice time.

Marissa
Senior Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: vat_certificate_template_guidance.docx (docx - template)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Li <sophie@stellartech.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Funding waterfall and milestone routing (StellarTech annual commit)

Sophie —

Thanks — two small implementation notes from the commercial side:

1) For the Escrow release condition, can you confirm the acceptance criteria (who signs the milestone)? We typically require a named approver and an acceptance doc (one-page). If you want auto-release at 60 days we can do that as a fallback.

2) For the bank wiring, please include your IBAN/ACH details and the remit contact. We will produce the three invoices once we have the ASN (account-specific) remit email and the VAT cert.

If it helps, I can draft the short invoice line wording (we'll include the ledger tag so accounting maps to the right commit).

—Ben
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Li <sophie@stellartech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinanceOps <acct@stellartech.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@stellartech.com>

Thanks all — confirming next steps:

- I'll upload StellarTech's VAT certificate and bank wiring details to the shared drive by EOD.
- Acceptance approver for milestones will be Tom Alvarez (tom.alvarez@stellartech.com) — he'll sign the one-page acceptance.
- We agree to escrow Invoice 2 until acceptance or auto-release at 60 days.

Sophie
